headline.purpose: Screen headings: question, result, lobby, interrupted.

label.purpose: Sentence-case field labels and quiet section labels.

numeric.purpose: Geist Mono timecode/measurement: round timer, room code, scores, ranks, percentages.

shadows.name: popover-lift
shadows.purpose: The guess suggestion panel only; the sole floating surface.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Inputs and the search field on focus, paired with a green border.

shadows.name: error-ring
shadows.purpose: Invalid fields, paired with a Miss Red border.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Slot fill (200ms), round reveal (240ms), cover unmask (440ms).

motion.name: disc-spin
motion.purpose: The mystery mark rotates while the extract plays, paused on reveal and under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single solid green action per screen: Jouer en solo, Valider, Manche suivante.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0.75rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 0.95rem/1.2 "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.005em; cursor: pointer; color: #04160c; background: #31d982; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4be495; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #31d982; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.42; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Tonal Button
components.description: Green text on a green-soft fill; keeps the home screen to one solid primary (Rejoindre).
components.css: .ds-btn-tonal { min-height: 48px; padding: 0.75rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid rgba(49,217,130,0.38); border-radius: 12px; font: 600 0.95rem/1.2 "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; color: #31d982; background: rgba(49,217,130,0.12); transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-tonal:hover { background: rgba(49,217,130,0.2); } .ds-btn-tonal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #31d982; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-tonal:disabled { opacity: 0.42; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The paired low-priority action on Plate High (Créer une partie, Retour à l'accueil).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0.75rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid #3a352f; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 0.95rem/1.2 "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; color: #f4f1ec; background: #1e1a17; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #463f38; background: #262019; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #31d982; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.42; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 40px; padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font: 500 0.9rem/1.2 "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; color: #a8a29a; background: transparent; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #f4f1ec; background: #1e1a17; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #31d982; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A sunken input or select with a quiet sentence-case label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field__label { color: #a8a29a; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-field__input { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid #2a2623; border-radius: 12px; color: #f4f1ec; caret-color: #31d982; background: #100e0d; font: 400 0.95rem/1.4 "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-field__input::placeholder { color: #a8a29a; } .ds-field__input:hover { border-color: #3a352f; } .ds-field__input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #31d982; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(49,217,130,0.18); }

components.name: Plate
components.description: The flat bordered surface every screen lives on.
components.css: .ds-plate { max-width: 560px; padding: 1.75rem; border: 1px solid #2a2623; border-radius: 18px; color: #f4f1ec; background: #171412; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-plate__title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.028em; } .ds-plate__body { margin: 0; color: #a8a29a; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Attempt Slot
components.description: A sunk guess row; tints green or red once an attempt lands.
components.html:
1. 1
  2. Djadja — Aya Nakamura
  3. La clé — Tiakola
components.css: .ds-slots { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 420px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-slot { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 42px; padding: 0.6rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid #2a2623; border-radius: 12px; background: #100e0d; color: #8a847c; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-slot__index { min-width: 1rem; color: #8a847c; font-family: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-slot__mark { width: 15px; height: 15px; align-self: center; } .ds-slot--wrong { border-color: rgba(255,107,107,0.42); background: rgba(255,107,107,0.1); color: #f6d7d2; } .ds-slot--wrong .ds-slot__mark { color: #ff6b6b; } .ds-slot--correct { border-color: rgba(49,217,130,0.38); background: rgba(49,217,130,0.12); color: #cdeedb; } .ds-slot--correct .ds-slot__mark { color: #31d982; }

components.name: Clock & Progress
components.description: The round clock: a Geist Mono readout over a green 6px fill that turns red in the final seconds.
components.html: 18,4 s
components.css: .ds-clock { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; width: 300px; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-clock__time { margin: 0; color: #f4f1ec; font-family: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 2.9rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1; } .ds-clock__track { height: 6px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px; background: #3a352f; } .ds-clock__fill { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: #31d982; transform-origin: left center; transition: transform 100ms linear, background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-clock--low .ds-clock__time { color: #ff6b6b; } .ds-clock--low .ds-clock__fill { background: #ff6b6b; }

components.name: Artwork Stage
components.description: Signature component: the square deck that holds the mystery mark, then the cover on reveal.
components.css: .ds-stage { margin: 0; } .ds-stage__frame { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: min(72vw, 300px); aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #2a2623; border-radius: 18px; background: #100e0d; } .ds-stage__disc { width: 52%; height: 52%; animation: ds-stage-spin 8s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-stage-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stage__disc { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Blindtest is a contemporary music player's now-playing screen, not a game console. Every screen is the same warm near-black room lit only by the album art: flat plates, 1px hairlines, soft radii, and a lot of quiet space. Nothing is textured, bevelled, glassy, or glowing. Where a state needs to speak - hit play, time running out, right answer, wrong answer - a single vivid green or a single red does the whole job.

The world was chosen for a room of friends passing phones and sharing one laptop: the extract is the product, so the cover is the only saturated object and the interface steps back. The mystery tile holds the secret track, the clock runs down beside it, and the real cover resolves out of the tile when the round ends. Colour is never decoration; it is either the artwork or a verdict.

Density is low and deliberate. Groups are tight, sections are generous, and the hierarchy is carried by one grotesque for words and one mono for measurement. The charm lives in restraint - a green progress line, a spinning note, a cover that arrives.
keyCharacteristics: A warm near-black ground with flat plates and 1px hairlines; no texture, bevel, glow, or hardware.
One vivid green accent for action, progress, and correct; one red for wrong. Nothing else is coloured.
Album art as the only broad source of colour, front and centre on the game stage.
Schibsted Grotesk for UI and display; Geist Mono for timecode numerals.
Soft 12-18px radii, pill-shaped meters and chips, generous whitespace.

rules.name: The Art-Is-The-Color Rule
rules.body: Broad colour comes only from album art. The interface itself paints exactly two signals - green and red - and nothing else. If a surface wants a new hue, it is wrong.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Green means action, progress, or correct; red means wrong or urgent. A green element that carries none of those meanings is decoration and does not ship.

rules.name: The Timecode-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is reserved for measurement - timer, room code, scores, ranks, percentages. It never sets a word. If a string is prose, it is Schibsted Grotesk.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at 0.82rem, not tracked uppercase. The old screen-print legend voice is gone; a control is named quietly.

rules.name: The Flat-Plate Rule
rules.body: Elevation is tone plus a hairline, never a cast shadow. The only floating surface in the product is the suggestion panel; adding a shadow anywhere else is drift.

dos: Do keep exactly one solid green primary action per screen; pair it with at most one secondary or tonal button.
Do let album art be the only broad colour; the UI itself paints only green (action/progress/correct) and red (wrong).
Do name controls with quiet sentence-case labels at 0.82rem, not tracked uppercase legends.
Do set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every changing number, and set measurement in Geist Mono.
Do express elevation as tone plus a 1px hairline; reserve the popover lift for the suggestion panel.
Do keep radii within 12-18px and reserve 999px pills for meters, chips and badges.
Do disable the disc rotation, the reveal scale and all transitions under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add texture, bevels, screws, walnut, brushed metal, or any skeuomorphic hardware - the analogue-console world is retired.
Don't add glow, neon, backdrop blur, glass, or gradient text.
Don't introduce a third signal colour; a new hue means the surface is off-system.
Don't tint scores, ranks or the leaderboard with the accent except for the current player and the winner.
Don't use pure black or pure gray ink; every neutral is warm.
Don't set words in Geist Mono, or write an uppercase eyebrow/kicker above a heading.
Don't nest a card inside a card; interior groups are flat tone changes or wells.
Don't replace the authored SVG icons, the mystery mark, or the music-note favicon with emoji or unicode glyphs.
